violations.title: FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY missing
violations.message: Table public.recipes has RLS enabled but not FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY. The table owner role still bypasses RLS, which often masks broken policies in development and CI. Run `ALTER TABLE public.recipes FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;`.

violations.title: Permissive policy grants access to PUBLIC
violations.message: Permissive policy 'published or mine' on public.recipes grants access to PUBLIC, so anonymous connections are governed by this policy's own clause — its USING for reads, its WITH CHECK for writes (a FOR INSERT policy has no USING at all). Restrict to a specific role (e.g. TO authenticated).

violations.title: All policies on table are permissive
violations.message: Every policy on public.recipes is permissive. Permissive policies combine with OR — adding one RESTRICTIVE policy gives a floor (e.g. tenant scoping) that no OR branch can bypass, for the roles in its own TO list. Use TO PUBLIC to bind every role: measured, a restrictive TO authenticated left authenticated at 1 row and another role at 3.
